"""Local independent declaration probe. No worker fixtures or test helpers imported."""
from pathlib import Path
import copy, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
CUSTODY = ROOT / '.cvf/runtime/ncr-review-continuation-local-20261015'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'governance/compat'))
import check_review_cost_control as production

results = []
def record(name, actual, expected):
    results.append(dict(name=name, actual=actual, expected=expected, passed=actual == expected))

def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
ART = ['governance/compat/probe_target.py', 'docs/reviews/probe_return.md', 'docs/reviews/evidence/probe.json']
SCOPE = dict(objectiveId='LOCAL-INDEPENDENT-ADMISSION', acceptanceItems=['A-LOCAL', 'B-LOCAL'],
    allowedArtifacts=ART, riskCeiling='SAME_AS_AUTHORIZED_PARENT',
    effectCeilings={k:0 for k in ['providerCalls','networkCalls','publicWrites','deployments','realDataMutations','destructiveActions','productRuntimeStarts']},
    numericalCeilings=dict(workerMinutes=20, reviewerMinutes=20), commitOwner='reviewer-closer')
GRANT = dict(schemaVersion='cvf.reviewDispatchContinuationAuthorization@1.0.0', decisionOwner='OPERATOR',
    operatorInstructionEvidence='Synthetic fixture: operator instruction verified separately by Local in the actual session.',
    status='ACTIVE', expiresAtUtc=None, validityDisposition='UNTIL_REVOKED_OR_SCOPE_CHANGE',
    binding=dict(parentAssignmentId='LOCAL-PROBE',rootCauseClusterId='LOCAL-DEPENDENT-ROOT',reviewRoundCount=3,
        reworkGeneration=3,priorFindingSetDigest='d'*64,dispatchSurface='INTERNAL_AGENT',commitMode='WORKER_MUST_NOT_COMMIT'),scope=SCOPE)
LEDGER = dict(schemaVersion='cvf.workOrderAcceptanceLedger@1.0.0',requirements=[dict(requirementId='LOCAL-REQ',mandatory=True,
    expectedArtifacts=ART,requiredProofIds=['LOCAL-PROOF'])],proofCatalog=[dict(proofId='LOCAL-PROOF',kind='offline',locator='probe#result')])
SOURCE = 'docs/reviews/local-grant.md'
WO = 'docs/work_orders/local-probe.md'

def grant_bytes(g):
    return ('# Independent fixture\n\n```operator-continuation-authorization-json\n'+json.dumps(g,indent=2)+'\n```\n').encode()

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cvf-local-probe-') as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    def put(p,b):
        dest=root/p; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(b)
    def diagnose(order): return production.diagnose(WO,order,root=root).is_clean
    raw=grant_bytes(GRANT); put(SOURCE,raw)
    args=[sys.executable,'-B',str(ROOT/'governance/compat/build_dispatch_packet_scaffold.py'),
        '--packet-kind','generic-worker-dispatch','--batch-id','LOCAL-PROBE','--title','Local isolated fixture',
        '--date','2026-10-15','--base','436c4cc8e','--commit-mode','WORKER_MUST_NOT_COMMIT',
        '--dispatch-kind','REWORK','--review-round-count','3','--root-cause-cluster-id','LOCAL-DEPENDENT-ROOT',
        '--prior-finding-set-digest','d'*64,'--stdout']
    flags=['--operator-continuation-evidence-path',SOURCE,'--operator-continuation-evidence-sha256',sha(raw)]
    def cli(extra): return subprocess.run(args+extra,cwd=root,capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    p=cli(flags); record('real process CLI emits cleared round three',p.returncode,0)
    assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
    (CUSTODY/'cli-output.txt').write_text(p.stdout,encoding='utf-8')
    order=p.stdout.split('=== Generated Work Order Skeleton ===',1)[1]
    order=re.sub(r'```acceptance-ledger-json\n.*?\n```','```acceptance-ledger-json\n'+json.dumps(LEDGER)+'\n```',order,flags=re.S)
    order=order.replace('reviewerLocalRepairBoundary: FILL_ME','reviewerLocalRepairBoundary: NEW_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED')
    order=order.replace('reviewerLocalRepairBasis: FILL_ME (cite the finding and controlling boundary)',
        'reviewerLocalRepairBasis: Independent fixture requires source evidence owned by the implementation worker.')
    record('completed generated order accepted',diagnose(order),True)
    record('scaffold generates two identical Commit mode declarations',len(re.findall(r'^Commit mode:',order,re.M)),2)
    record('identical Commit mode repeat accepted',diagnose(order+'\nCommit mode: WORKER_MUST_NOT_COMMIT\n'),True)
    record('conflicting Commit mode rejected',diagnose(order+'\nCommit mode: WORKER_MAY_COMMIT\n'),False)
    record('duplicate round scalar rejected',diagnose(order+'\nreviewRoundCount: 3\n'),False)
    for name,changed in [
        ('wrong source hash',order.replace(sha(raw),'0'*64)),
        ('partial declaration',re.sub(r'^operatorContinuationEvidenceSha256:.*\n','',order,flags=re.M)),
        ('tilde scope opener',order.replace('```continuation-scope-json','~~~continuation-scope-json')),
        ('four backtick scope opener',order.replace('```continuation-scope-json','````continuation-scope-json')),
        ('scope list reorder',order.replace('"A-LOCAL",\n    "B-LOCAL"','"B-LOCAL",\n    "A-LOCAL"')),
        ('scope numeric type substitution',order.replace('"workerMinutes": 20','"workerMinutes": 20.0')),
        ('critical placeholder',order.replace('newIndependentCriticalEvidence: NONE','newIndependentCriticalEvidence: FILL_ME')),
        ('dependency audit retained',order.replace('dependencyAuditDisposition: COMPLETE_BEFORE_FIRST_REPAIR','dependencyAuditDisposition: NONE')),
        ('successor restriction retained',order.replace('successorTrancheOpened: NO','successorTrancheOpened: YES')),
        ('ledger union mismatch',order.replace('"expectedArtifacts": [','"expectedArtifacts": ["docs/reviews/additional.md",')),
    ]:
        record(name,diagnose(changed),False)
    for name,edit in [
        ('revoked',lambda g:g.update(status='REVOKED')),
        ('expired',lambda g:g.update(validityDisposition='UNTIL_UTC_EXPIRY',expiresAtUtc='2000-01-01T00:00:00Z')),
        ('grant bool substituted for integer',lambda g:g['scope']['effectCeilings'].update(providerCalls=False)),
        ('grant wrong parent',lambda g:g['binding'].update(parentAssignmentId='OTHER-PARENT')),
        ('grant unknown key',lambda g:g.update(unknown=0)),
        ('worker writable source',lambda g:g['scope']['allowedArtifacts'].append(SOURCE)),
    ]:
        g=copy.deepcopy(GRANT); edit(g); altered=grant_bytes(g); put(SOURCE,altered)
        record(name,diagnose(order.replace(sha(raw),sha(altered))),False)
    for name,altered in [
        ('duplicate nested JSON member',raw.replace(b'"providerCalls": 0',b'"providerCalls": 0, "providerCalls": 0')),
        ('malformed grant four backticks',raw.replace(b'```operator-',b'````operator-')),
        ('malformed grant tildes',raw.replace(b'```operator-',b'~~~operator-')),
        ('source over byte limit',raw+b' ' * 65536),
        ('source invalid UTF8',raw+b'\xff'),
    ]:
        put(SOURCE,altered); record(name,diagnose(order.replace(sha(raw),sha(altered))),False)
    put(SOURCE,raw)
    record('legacy CLI round three stops',cli([]).returncode,2)
    record('partial CLI flag stops',cli(flags[:2]).returncode,2)
    put(WO,order.encode())
    telemetry=dict(reviewRoundCount=3,workerRepairTurnCount=1,newRootCauseCountThisRound=0,dependentFindingCountThisRound=1,
        elapsedReviewMinutes=10,providerCallCount=0,tokenOrQuotaUsage='NOT_AVAILABLE_WITH_REASON: local fixture',
        valueDelta='Disposition of one dependent declaration fixture.',stopDisposition='COMPLETE_REVIEW',
        preRepairAuditDisposition='COMPLETE_BEFORE_FIRST_REPAIR',materialCommitCount=1,continuityCommitCount=1,
        commitPlanDisposition='DEFAULT_ONE_MATERIAL_ONE_CONTINUITY',latencyDisposition='WITHIN_FAST_PATH_TARGET',avoidableDelayClass='NONE')
    completion='# Local fixture\nStatus: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED\ndocType: completion_review\nReview-Cost Telemetry: REQUIRED\n\n'
    completion+='\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in telemetry.items())+'\n'
    link=f'continuationWorkOrderPath: {WO}\ncontinuationWorkOrderSha256: {sha(order.encode())}\n'
    def done(t): return production.diagnose('docs/reviews/local-completion.md',t,root=root).is_clean
    record('bound completion complete permitted',done(completion+link),True)
    record('bound completion consolidate permitted',done((completion+link).replace('stopDisposition: COMPLETE_REVIEW','stopDisposition: CONSOLIDATE_SINGLE_REPAIR')),True)
    record('unlinked round three stays stopped',done(completion),False)
    record('bad completion raw hash stays stopped',done(completion+link.replace(sha(order.encode()),'0'*64)),False)
    record('completion round mismatch',done((completion+link).replace('reviewRoundCount: 3','reviewRoundCount: 4')),False)
    record('new critical still requires positive root count',done((completion+link).replace('stopDisposition: COMPLETE_REVIEW','stopDisposition: CONTINUE_NEW_CRITICAL_EVIDENCE')),False)
    record('park token stays rejected',done((completion+link).replace('stopDisposition: COMPLETE_REVIEW','stopDisposition: PARK_LOW_INCREMENTAL_VALUE')),False)
    sym=root/'docs/reviews/file-link.md'
    try:
        os.symlink(root/SOURCE,sym)
    except (OSError,NotImplementedError) as e:
        symlink=dict(disposition='UNAVAILABLE_WITH_REASON',reason=type(e).__name__,winerror=getattr(e,'winerror',None))
    else:
        linked=order.replace(SOURCE,'docs/reviews/file-link.md'); record('real file symlink rejected',diagnose(linked),False)
        symlink=dict(disposition='EXECUTED_FILE_SYMLINK')

out=dict(schemaVersion='cvf.localIndependentProbe@1.0.0',cases=results,passed=sum(r['passed'] for r in results),
    failed=sum(not r['passed'] for r in results),fileSymlink=symlink,probeScriptSha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()))
(CUSTODY/'probe-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
sys.exit(bool(out['failed']))
